items.name: mus_sneak
items.text: Sneaky tiptoe comedic music, light pizzicato strings and plucked pipa, soft woodblock ticks, playful suspense, quiet, ancient Chinese palace at dawn, no vocals, 100 bpm

items.name: mus_hero_sting
items.text: Short grand heroic fanfare sting, Chinese brass and a big taiko hit, majestic and a little over the top, comedic pomp, ends on a held chord, no vocals

items.name: mus_march
items.text: Confident playful march, plucked guzheng and dizi flute over light drums, an emperor striding through his palace, upbeat, no vocals, 110 bpm

items.name: mus_busy
items.text: Busy comedic office music, quick plucked guzheng ostinato and wood block, paperwork montage, light and bouncy, ancient Chinese court, no vocals, 104 bpm

items.name: mus_mystic
items.text: Mysterious shimmering music with a shady comic edge, glass chimes, low bowed strings and a sly woodwind line, a charlatan alchemist with big promises, ancient China, no vocals

items.name: mus_night
items.text: Stealthy night music, low plucked bass, soft hand drum and a breathy flute, sneaky suspense, ancient Chinese night outing, quiet, no vocals, 90 bpm

items.name: mus_action
items.text: Sudden fast action percussion, pounding taiko drums and urgent strings, an ambush in the dark, short and intense, no vocals

items.name: mus_pomp
items.text: Short pompous comedic royal fanfare, small brass, cymbal and gong, a solemn ceremony for something silly, no vocals

items.name: mus_museum
items.text: Gentle bittersweet ending music, soft piano and erhu with warm strings, the last scene of a documentary, slow, hopeful, no vocals

items.name: amb_court
items.text: Ancient palace office in the morning, scribes writing with brushes, bamboo slips clacking softly, rustling, quiet indoor room tone

items.name: amb_coast
items.text: Seashore, gentle waves on sand, seagulls calling, light sea wind

items.name: amb_city_far
items.text: Distant ancient city below a high stone terrace, faint crowd murmur, horse carts rolling, hooves, wind

items.name: amb_road
items.text: Hot dry desert road, dry wind, horses snorting and shifting, a wooden carriage creaking, distant cicadas

items.name: amb_museum_crowd
items.text: Large museum hall, soft murmur of visitors, occasional echoing footsteps, quiet reverent atmosphere

items.name: sfx_poweroff
items.text: An old camcorder power button click, then an old CRT television switching off: a falling electric whine and a soft static pop, then silence

items.name: sfx_blush
items.text: Cute soft magical sparkle chime, short and gentle

items.name: sfx_taiko
items.text: One huge taiko drum hit with a deep cinematic boom
